question: Why is my phone running slow?
answer: Slow performance is usually caused by too many background apps, low storage space, or an outdated software version. Try clearing cache, closing unused apps, and updating to the latest software.

question: How do I update my phone's software?
answer: Go to Settings > System > Software Update, then tap Check for Updates. If an update is available, tap Download and Install.

question: My phone camera is not working properly, what should I do?
answer: Restart your phone first. If the issue continues, clear the camera app's cache from Settings > Apps, or contact a service center if the problem persists.

question: What is the warranty period for my phone?
answer: All new phones come with a standard 12-month warranty from the date of purchase, covering manufacturing defects.

question: How do I claim my phone's warranty?
answer: Visit your nearest authorized service center with your phone and original purchase receipt. Our team will inspect the device and process your claim.

question: Does warranty cover a cracked screen?
answer: No, physical damage such as a cracked screen is not covered under standard warranty. Screen repairs are available at an additional cost through our service centers.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept credit/debit cards, bank transfers, mobile wallets, and cash on delivery in select cities.

question: Can I buy a phone on installments?
answer: Yes, installment plans are available through selected banks and partner services. Options and eligibility can be checked at checkout.

question: I was charged twice for my order, what should I do?
answer: Please contact our billing support with your order ID and payment screenshot, and we will investigate and refund any duplicate charge within 5-7 business days.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days within major cities, and 5-7 business days for other areas.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Once your order is shipped, you will receive a tracking link via SMS and email. You can also track it from the Orders section in your account.

question: My order is delayed, who do I contact?
answer: If your order is delayed beyond the estimated delivery date, please reach out to our shipping support with your order ID so we can look into it.

question: What is your return policy?
answer: You can return a phone within 7 days of delivery if it is unused and in its original packaging with all accessories.

question: How long does a refund take after a return?
answer: Refunds are processed within 7-10 business days after the returned item passes inspection.

question: Can I exchange my phone for a different model?
answer: Yes, exchanges are allowed within 7 days of delivery, subject to price difference and product availability.

question: What is the price of the latest model?
answer: Pricing varies by storage and color variant. Please check the product page for the latest price and available options.

question: Is this phone available in different colors?
answer: Yes, most models are available in multiple color options, which you can view on the product page before ordering.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Tap Sign Up on the app or website, enter your name, email, and phone number, and verify with the OTP sent to you.

question: I forgot my account password, how do I reset it?
answer: Tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen, enter your registered email, and follow the link sent to you to set a new password.
